content: Yesus ano
Arono naije Akarijo Titi Roma apa tame mi Agustus po apa ayao rauguje indamu po vatano mine so awa wanuije rator.
Po ratoro manasyimbe mamo arono Kirenius be gubernurive no propinsijo Siria.
Weti vatan tenambe wuruta no awa munije rai janyi, indamu awa tame ratoe tetebe.
Weti Yusup puje no munijo Nasaret no no propinsijo Galilea, to no Betlehem no no propinsijo Yudea, omamo aneno Daud apa munije mije, weye Yusup pamo avaki no Daud apa susye rai.
Yusup to no Betlehem indamu pemerinta po apa tame ratoe. Muno Maria ntavondi, wemirati ama vainye rave Yusup ai. Omamo mbe ranakeave to.

Yare syisya no yavaro vatano marane udea unaki raive inta rai, weramu yavare umawe ngkatutundijo vatane mai to. Weti yurija nyaki yavaro maero makume usai daije bo rai. Umbawe Maria ntuna kobe ama arikainyo anya manasyine umaso autan. Mo ansune vasye veano atavan, umba mo augasyo nikijo ugano veano maere awa anaisye raveaje raije ama uga rai.
Naito Amisye wo Yesus apa ano raije raura vatano wo domba maeranande mai
Namano napije vatano wo domba maeranande inta una no anoko insumaije ntami rai, mararaijo munijo Betlehem umawe rai.
Naije kobe naito Amisye inta paje anasine rarorono mai, muno Amisye apa varo ngkove mbaro mai tenambe, ti ujani dave.
Umba naito Amisye umaso po raura nanto mai pare, “Vemo wajaniv inya. Namane so ide wasai indamu syo ayao kove so raura wasai. Ayao kove so indati mo anayanambe raugavo vatan tenambe mansai.
Namane soamo arikainye inta ano no Daud apa munijo Betlehem. Arikainye sopamo Mesias, wapa Akarijo Titi pije, wepirati Amisye po atutir indamu Po vatane mapaya ayao kakaije rai.
Syo raura wusyimbe wasai, inda wata wananta arikainye umaso Ai: Indati wapo aen atavano ansune vasye rai, muno augasyo nikijo ugano veano maere awa anaisye raveaje raije ama uga rai.”
Umba naije kobe naito Amisy wanui rave waje utavono naite umawe ai, umba wo raura ware:

content.text: “Amisye ararimbe, Opi no no munijo ntiti!
Po kovo saumane raugaje mine vone so rai,
nde vatano are nawirati Amisye anayanambe maije mai.”

content: Umba naito Amisye wuje wakata no munijo ntiti, naije vatano wo domba maeranande umawe wo raura vambinibe mansai ware, “Wade ra wanta no Betlehem inda wamo ana uma Amisye po raura wansaije we raen.”
Wavave wuruta, umba unanta Maria me Yusupa pe arikainye umaso pe mai. Wo arikainye umaso aen nikijo ugano veano maere awa anaisye raveaje raije ama uga rai.
Umba wo anakotaro naito Amisye po raura maijoe ravov.
Muno vatano wanuije wo ayao uma vatano wo domba maeranande wo raura we ranaun, weti unantaive rave tenambe.
Maria mamo raemeno ayao umaso rai tenambe muno mo ratantona no ranuga rai tutir.
Umba vatano wo domba maeranande umaso wakare no anoko insumaije ntami raije umawe rai, ukangkamambe muno wo Amisye ararimbe, weye ana wo raen umawe mamaisyo naito Amisye po raura maijoe rai.

Arono arikainye umaso Apa masyote kaumandei, naije vatane ude indamu wo sunative Ai indamu mamaisyo Ananyao Musa rai. Umba wo Apa tame veano awainamo Yesus. Tame somamo naito Amisye po raura to no arono akoya ranakea raeno autan dainyoe.
Yesus apatimugo Amisye ai

Umba masyoto manasine rarondom mamaisyo Ananyao Musa rai ndea mamaisy. Weti Yusupa pe Maria me yo aya arikainyo Yesus augaveta no Yerusalem. Yurija syisya no Yavaro Amisye rai indamu yo Yesus apatimugo Amisye ai.
Maisyare Ayao Amisye mo ratoe mare, “Arikainyo anya ano manasyimbe wepamo apatimugo Amisye ai indamu apaura ai.”
Yare yo insanijo puname jiruma yameseo Amisye ai tavon indamu mamaisyo Ananyao Amisye rai.

Arono naije vatane inta no no Yerusalem, apa tame mirati Simeon, opamo vatano kov muno po Amisye asyaniv. Muno Anawayo Vambunine no irati ai. Po Mesias apa deye ranyut, Wepirati pare po vatano Israel mapaya kakaije rai.
Anawayo Vambunin mo raurairive Simeon ai wusyimbe to mare, “Winyamo wingkakai rainy yara noa indati nyo Amisye apa Mesias aeno taune namije rai rati.”

Masyoto naije Anawayo Vambunin mo Simeon atutir indamu de no Yavaro Amisy. Arono naije Yusupa pe Maria me yo Yesus augave syisya no Yavaro Amisye ama uga indamu yo augavere no Amisye amun maisyare muno Ananyao Musa mo raura wemaisy.
Umba Simeon po Yesus aijade po akepano aneme rai umba po Amisye ararimbe pare:

content.text: “Amisyo winy, naisoamo Nyo nya urairije ravea mamai to,
weti nyare Nyo inaugav, weamo Nyo inauga kai.
weye syo Vatano po Israel mapaya kakaije raije aeno inamije rai to.
Opamo Nyo atayao indamu Po kove raunanto vatano una no mine tename so raije mai.
Opamo aurata irati varo mbaro vatano Yahudi jewene mansai,
muno Po kovo ntiti raugavere Nya kawasae Israel mansai.”

content: Yusupa pe Maria me unantaive ayao Simeon po raura nanto aya Arikainye aije rai.

Umba Simeon po Amisye anajo indamu Po kove raugaje yai, umba po raura nanto Maria rai pare, “Arikainye sopamo Amisye po apatimu to, indati Wepi bewar vatano Israel wanui ude Amisye ai ti Po kove mai yara wanui kaijinta nawamo wonayo Ai ti po mangke raugaje mai. Weye opirati Vatano Amisye po aroron ti atutir deye so, weramu vatano wanui indati wo awatambe,
wirati awa ana wo ratantona no manuga raroron kakavimbe. Muno winyamo indati nanimaumbe rave, maisyare omako nsiuge inta nteto nanuga rai wemaisy, arono nyo Apa siurije raen!”

Naije wanya kavinije inta, ama tame mi Hana, omamo anawae Amisye ma. Ama aja pamo Panuel, opamo avaki no susyo Asyer rai. Omamo mbe vatan anuive rave. Wusyinoe mo anya inta aovan, inya tenambea tume kaururum,

umba ama ana umaso kakai, ti Hana mbe kavinive. Umba mbe kavinive nugoenta rave weye soamo ama tume tename mambisy eane mambisy. Omamo mo Yavaro Amisye rapaya ramu, yara namane rinit no tawan no rai tutir, manapatambe Amisye ai, nsambayambe muno ratawandijo marore rai.

Arono naije kobe, wanya umaso nde mo kove raura seo Amisye ai, muno mo arikainyo Yesus umaso aura kakavimbe nanto vatano wo masyoto Amisye po vatano Israel mapaya kakaije raije ranyute mansai tenambe.
Yusupa pe Maria me yo Yesus augavakata no Nasaret
Arono Yusupa pe Maria me ibeta Ananyao Amisye po raugaje rai tenambea mewen, unajiv wakata no munijo Nasaret no no Galilea.
Arikainye umaso panakoe piridije seo, muno bambunin, muno Apa ana po ratantona mba dave. Amisye po kovo manakoe raugaje Ai.
Yesus apa tume abusyinara eane rurum, umba siso Yavaro Amisye rai
Tume anteter Yesus apa aja pe akoya me yurija no Yerusalem indamu itavondijo Ono Paska rai.
Yesus apa tume abusyinara eane rurum, umba yo auga ti wuruta Ono Paska rai, mamaisyo awa koano utavondi raivea nsiridi to rai.
Arono one umawe mewen, Yesus apa aja pe akoya me inyajiv, yara aya kavo Yesus opamo ta no no Yerusalem, weramu aja pe akoya me yantatukambe.
Yo rakarae yare aya kavo tavondijo awa arakove inta mai ti udijata. Yanya masyote intai, umba yaemeno Ai, ti yo akani no aya arakove umawe awa yasyin.
Weramu nyanta Aije ramu, ti yakare no Yerusalem indamu yo akani.
Sisa masyoto mandeije rai, umba nyanta Ai no Yavaro Amisy ama uga. Yo aen tuna no kuruno Yahudi awa yasyin, Po awa ananyaowe raraniv, muno Po manajo.
Vatano wo anaun unantaive rave tenambe, weye Apa ana datantona ntiti muno Apa ana daura mba dave.

Arono Yusupa pe Maria me yo Yesus aen, ipaparo yai. Apa akoya mo aura to mare, “Sya arikainyo Winy, mbeanimaibe Nyo ririnsaveare somaisy? Risye inya pe ririnsanuga nseo majeve weye ririmo nakanija marudi.”
Umba Yesus po raura akananto yai pare, “Injae, Ingkoe, ribeanimaibe irati ipo inakani? Wuripantukambe Risyamo sya Injaya po inatutir indamu ino no Apa yavare ama uga.”
Weramu Apa aja pe akoya me nyanta irati Apa ana po raura yai raije ramu.
Umba Yesus tavondi yai, wakata tenambe no Nasaret. Animaisye mirati aja pe akoya me yo raura Ai, omamo Yesus beto rai kobe. Muno Apa akoya raemeno anakotare umaso rai tenambe no ranuga.
Umba Yesus panakoe piridije seo muno Apa ana po ratantona miridije nseo titive. Amisye anayanambe Ai muno vatane manayanambe Ai tavon.
